objective.why: Customers act on these dates and fields. Today we cannot tell which of them to trust.

good.label: Provable submission dates

objective.note: Targets are proposed, not agreed. Edit them in docs/design/status.json.
why_points: The date can be wrong while labelled verified: one stored deadline was a registration date, and 12 of 39 stored deadlines read 'verified' on call status alone, not on the date.
Everything else we collect (organiser, sponsorship, categories, overview, about 24 fields) arrives at varying quality, from different sources, and none of it has been measured.
There is no method yet that proves a field's quality, so improvements are judged by feel and we correct after the customer complains.
The weekend research fails about 73% of its Gemini calls, September cost $134, and weeks of building still need manual rescue.
objective.why_close: So the project is as much a way to prove quality, field by field and step by step, as it is a way to collect data.
